auth.howToCopy: No token needed: search and job pages are public and were read as a guest (no cookies). Salary appears in the job page JSON-LD even as a guest.

clauses: không được lấy, hiển thị, sửa đổi, sao chép, in, bán, tải về, cho thuê, thiết kế ngược lại hoặc truyền đi

accountRisk: Low. Reads are guest page GETs, so Ba's ITviec account is not involved. The terms (effective 1 July 2023, updated 08/12/2025) have no clause on bots or automated access; section 2.2 forbids taking/copying/downloading site content without written consent. robots.txt (2026-10-19) says 'Allow all bots to crawl the entire site except one page' (/subscriptions/new). No reports found of accounts restricted for automated reading.
notes: No JSON API: server-rendered Rails/Turbo HTML; read JSON-LD. Search page JSON-LD @type ItemList: itemListElement[].url = canonical job URLs (20 per page, fixture trimmed to 5); pagination ?page=N. Search HTML cards (div.job-card) carry data-search--job-selection-job-slug-value, title (h3 a), 'Posted N hours ago', and data-search--job-selection-job-url-value = '/it-jobs/<slug>/content?job_index=0&locale=en' (an HTML fragment with the full JD; the 'other' endpoint). Detail page /it-jobs/<slug>-<number>: JSON-LD @type JobPosting with title, description (full JD HTML incl. 'Top 3 reasons', 'The Job', skills, 'Why you'll love working here'), datePosted, validThrough, skills, hiringOrganization, jobLocation (PostalAddress list), baseSalary (min/max, currency, value text e.g. '1,500 - 3,000 USD'), employmentType, potentialAction ApplyAction (apply URL: recorded under applyEndpoints, documentedOnly, never call). Strip ?lab_feature=... from URLs. Detail page ~330 KB. Observed with guest curl (Chrome extension was not connected); no XHR JSON endpoints observed. /api/v1/tags/populars exists (search autocomplete), not useful for jobs.
